testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23073 missing mandatory fields are rejected when creating a sales rep

scenario.summary: On Add Sales Rep the admin leaves All Stores unchecked with no store selected, leaves every field blank and clicks Save and Close; the required messages are shown in red against Stores, Username, First Name and Last Name and nothing is saved.
steps: On the Sales Rep listing click Add New.
Leave All Stores unchecked and select no store (deviation from the case's 'check All Stores', user decision 2026-11-25).
assertions: 'Please select at least one Store.', 'Username is required.', 'First Name is required.' and 'Last Name is required.' are displayed against their fields in red
Saving is prevented (the admin stays on Add Sales Rep)
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
Test case Z10-TC-23073 (AIO export): the four messages are its expected texts.
FSD 'Create a Sales Rep': required-field validation as in the user module.
No data need: the form is left blank.
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.

Deviation (user decision 2026-11-25): the case checks All Stores, but on atstage 10.14.7.0 All Stores counts as a selected store and no Stores message is shown (run 2026-11-25, Username/First/Last messages only). The test leaves All Stores unchecked so the case's four expected messages apply.
